structure: A central rounded swirl grows from sparse white points into a broad cloudy disc.
Separate oval or crescent lobes sit outside the central disc, including upper-right and lower-left areas.
Soft plastic-like shading gives curved surfaces small white specular highlights.
The disc has a dark central recess and curved internal seams rather than dense straight-line mesh.
motion: The main rounded form expands substantially through the two-second window.
Curved internal seams rotate/deform while the outer lobes drift around the centre.
Tracked median motion is about 0.13 viewport widths per second, with faster local highlights.
Movement is continuous across the window rather than repeated full-screen cuts.
colour: Large unoccupied regions remain black; mean luma is about 0.119.
Most visible material is grey/white with subdued green, purple and pink tinting.
Small white highlights are substantially brighter than the central recess.
Coloured tinting strengthens over time, but mean saturation remains low, about 0.079.
flashing: Zero coherent brightening transitions are predicted in these 60 frames.
Zero coherent darkening transitions are predicted in these 60 frames.
Maximum mean brightness jump is small, about 0.010.
Occasional local highlight changes affect much less than 20 percent of the screen.
feedback: An initially sparse image accumulates into larger cloudy rounded surfaces.
Per-vertex warp is gated to a radial band, so deformation is spatially localized.
Blur gradients drive the composite bump lighting and sculpt the highlighted seams.
Retained structures persist between frames, producing layered surfaces and curved lobes.
